instructions: Clear both {mat} and {tray}. Put every cube from either place directly on the bare table, completely outside both.
Empty the tray and clear the mat onto the bare tabletop. If the tray contains a second cube, remove that cube too.
Both {mat} and {tray} should end up empty. Move their cubes onto uncovered table space, not onto each other or onto either destination.
Take the cube off {mat}, then take every cube out of {tray}. Set each one directly on the table with no footprint overlapping the mat or tray.
Move all cubes supported by {mat} or contained in {tray} to bare tabletop positions completely clear of both. Include an extra tray cube if present.
Make the mat and tray cube-free: remove the mat occupant and every tray occupant, placing all of them directly on the uncovered table.
notes: Requires simultaneous clearance of a flat support and a container, with an optional second container occupant and no transfer between the two supports.
